newsitem.title: UK: U.S. shares in London cautious ahead of data.
newsitem.headline: U.S. shares in London cautious ahead of data.

text.p: U.S. stocks in London were mixed on Thursday despite the Dow's record close, as investors remained wary ahead of a stream of U.S. economic indicators today.
"Interest has been stock-specific," said one trader. "It's difficult to call a trend...all eyes are on the indicators."
Dealers said there was buying interest in Apple Computer after the company unexpectedly reported fourth quarter profits of $25 million after-hours.
The computer maker posted a profit of 20 cents a share, compared with forecasts of a 30 cents loss. The shares were offered at $28-1/2 in London after a New York close of $25-3/4.
Elsewhere traders said investors were likely to remain cautious ahead of the economic data.
"It will be a pretty confusing day, with numbers just before Wall Street opens, it's anybody's guess as to how the Dow will go," one said.
September housing starts are scheduled for 1230 GMT, along with weekly jobless claims. But investors will focus on industrial production and capacity utilisation due at 1315 GMT.
At 1400 GMT, business inventories and the Philadelphia Fed Index are likely to grab the spotlight.

"The general trend in this market is still pretty bullish," a dealer said. "The tick up at the end of the day suggests a strong underlying bullish tone and we're looking for the indicators to confirm that."
The Dow Industrials shook off sharp early losses to chalk up a new record closing high on Wednesday. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 4027
